atoms.b: ((++This,_that,_these_and_those Who,_what,_why_and_when)) are demonstrative adjectives. They are used to demonstrate which ((++thing_or_person verb_or_verbal)) is being referred to.

instruction.text: Match the demonstrative adjectives with the correct definition.

atoms.b: I believe ((++these those)) jeans fit me better than my other ones at home.
((++That This)) mountain ridge to the left is where we are headed to.
Did you see all of ((++those these)) wild bison grazing on the plains?
Look at the way ((++this these)) marble is shining in the light.
Is ((++that this)) your car all the way on the other side of the car park?
((++This That)) is our newest pup, Isaiah.
((++Those These)) lifeguard trainees are on their way to rescue someone.
The book you are looking for should be in ((++that this)) bookshelf at the end of the aisle.
